meta.requirement: Explore Stormterror's Lair (20%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Standoff
start.text:
Marek: ''from the stairwell'' I said the ledgers stay with the guild!

Hoarder: Yeah? Tower fell. Finders keepers.

Marek: Then come up here and take them.

''Silence. Nobody moves.''

Marek: ''spotting you'' Oh, thank the Anemo. Don't just stand there.

On_my_way.text:
Marek: ''without looking at you'' Middle one first. They hate that.

Hoarder: Guild sent backup? Fine. We were getting bored anyway.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Break the standoff on the vault stair at Stormterror's Lair

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Break the Standoff. Defeat 3 [[Treasure Hoarder Crusher]]

Break_the_Standoff.text:
Marek: You alright? Good. Me too. Satchel too, mostly.

''He checks the folios and swears once.''

Marek: Pike. Fourth guy, on lookout. While you were swinging he ripped out the index page and ran. Without that page I can't prove what was in the vault before these idiots started shopping.

Marek: I'm slow on this leg. Go to Mondstadt, tell Lenora at the guild counter that Pike's got guild paper and he's running. She'll know what to do.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Marek's report to Lenora at the Adventurers' Guild in Mondstadt City

continues.label: If you do /rpg again and click on Talk to Marek
Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Report to Lenora

Report_to_Lenora.text:
Lenora: ''still stamping forms'' If you're here about Marek, I already heard the short version from a guard on the west road.

''She sets the stamp down.''

Lenora: Pike. Small-time Hoarder lookout, bad knee, worse judgment. He caches stolen goods near the old oak at Windrise. Bren in Springvale buys anything with a seal on it, no questions. Marek is probably right. Pike's trying to sell that page tonight.

''She slides you a scrap of map with two marks.''

Lenora: Check Windrise first. If Pike's already moved on, Bren's your last stop before the page ends up in someone's private collection forever.

whos_bren.text:
Lenora: Fence. Buys 'found' paperwork from ruin runs. ''dry'' We have asked him nicely to stop. He asks nicely back. We keep a list.

Lenora: Pike is not clever enough to skip the oak. Go look before you knock on Bren's door.

Windrise_first.text: Lenora: ''already back to her forms'' Tell Marek I said good work if you see him before I do. And bring the page back in one piece. I do not want to rewrite a vault inventory from memory.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Search for Pike's trail near Windrise

continues.label: Go to Windrise (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Search Pike's Trail

Search_Pike_s_Trail.text:
''Cold ash under the split oak. Someone left in a hurry.''

''Under a flat stone, a note in bad handwriting:''

''Bren won't pay full till he sees the seal. Springvale road fork after dark. Come alone. Signed with a little fish drawing.''

''So much for clever.''

Springvale_road_fork__Got_it.text:
Lenora was right. Pike cached here and bolted for Springvale.

''If Bren's waiting at that road fork, he is not waiting alone.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Stop Pike from selling the vault ledger page at Springvale

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Confront Pike at the Road Fork

Confront_Pike_at_the_Road_Fork.text:
Bren: ''from beside a broken cart'' We're closed.

Pike: ''too fast, page in hand'' Who's this?

Pike: You again? Marek send you? Tell him the page's worth more than his whole satchel!

''He drops the page and reaches for his club.''

Bren: ''already backing away'' I didn't touch it! I was only looking!

Pike: Bren, you paying or not?

Bren: ''from the trees'' Not for this!

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Stop Pike from selling the vault ledger page at Springvale

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Fight Pike and the Hoarders. Defeat 2 [[Treasure Hoarder Crusher]]

____Standoff__Standoff_Broken.title: Standoff Broken
____Standoff__Standoff_Broken.text:
Pike: ''face-down in the mud'' I want a lawyer.

Marek: ''jogging in'' You want a bandage. Shut up.

''He picks up the page, checks the seal, and counts coins into your palm.''

Marek: Lenora said double. And Pike can tell the Knights about the vault stairs once he stops spitting mud.
